a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted roster 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention. a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time. Both cover the same 2,000 samples; an exposure row must carry whichever value the code path that builds its ExecutionPlan computes.
a2t_calibration_key_names: The a2t_calibration_* key names are the flight-family contract scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py and scripts/a2t_calibration_prompt_fit.py read; reusing them is what lets this roster fly through the SAME entry point and the SAME FlightRuntime as every other Audio2Tool direct cell, with no new code path. The keys name a receipt-scoped roster, not the calibration split.
a2t_calibration_population: The RELEASE's own populations of the four tiers the eight-tier table still lacks at n = 500: for every query_* directory of each tier, the first recording the released loader resolves. On tier3_multi_intent (2,146 directories), tier4_implicit (2,132) and tier6_correction (2,146) that is the shipped speaker with the lowest speaker_idx -- the manifest row with the lowest id -- exactly as on tiers 1 and 2. On tier7_multiturn (2,146 directories, 2,092 after this repository's two identity exclusions) the released loader ignores generation_results.csv entirely and returns sorted(query_dir.glob('turn_*_user_*.wav')), so BenchmarkEvaluator's audio_paths[0] is the FIRST user turn's wav, with no chat history and no agent turn in the prompt; the tier manifest's own chat_history[0] names that same file with a matching duration on all 2,146 directories. 500 of each tier's population are then drawn uniformly without replacement with seed 20260803, giving 2,000 rows with tier as the stratum. Builder: scripts/build_a2t_tier258_official_population_roster.py --group tier3467; roster receipt above; the receipt carries the directory-by-directory replay of each tier's released loader (tier 3: 2,146 agreements, 0 disagreements, 0 unresolved; tier 4: 2,132 agreements, 0 disagreements, 0 unresolved, including the seven directories that ship three or four recordings and the two duplicated manifest rows; tier 6: 2,146 agreements; tier 7: 2,146 chat_history[0] agreements and turn_00 first on every directory). Domain mix of the draws: tier3 smart_home 368 / wearables 91 / smart_car 41 (population 1590 / 390 / 166); tier4 smart_home 375 / wearables 90 / smart_car 35 (1576 / 390 / 166); tier6 smart_home 368 / wearables 91 / smart_car 41 (1590 / 390 / 166); tier7 smart_home 380 / wearables 84 / smart_car 36 (1557 / 373 / 162 after exclusions). Overlap with the frozen 400, by query: 10 of the 50 tier-3 queries, 13 of the 50 tier-4, 12 of the 50 tier-6 and 0 of the 50 tier-7; by sample id: 6 / 7 / 5 / 0.
a2t_calibration_tier7_exclusions: 54 of the 2,146 tier-7 queries are excluded from the population BEFORE the draw, both exclusions forced by this repository rather than by the release and both named id by id in the roster receipt. (1) 50 tier-7 sample ids are already inside the immutable docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-identity.json as part of the frozen 400, bound there to the FINAL user turn because data.audio2tool._entry_media reads chat_history[-1]; contracts.gate_media_identity refuses a D1 supplement that duplicates a base D1 sample and re-hashes the flown file against the base record, so a first-user-turn binding of those same ids could never reach the frozen core. (2) Four rows (ids 373, 1258, 1744, 2023) end their chat_history on an AGENT turn, which that same _entry_media refuses, so admitting one into a probe-sample receipt would break load_official_gold for every Audio2Tool scoring job. The draw is uniform over the remaining 2,092, which is 97.5 % of the released tier-7 population; the excluded 50 are themselves the frozen 400's own tier-7 rows and the excluded 4 are a release defect.
a2t_calibration_d1_media_supplement: 1,982 of the 2,000 sample ids are NEW to the immutable D1 identity closure and are carried by the additive receipt named above (docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-a2t-tier3467-official-population-2000.json, schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1, 570,747,430 bytes). The other 18 (6 tier-3, 7 tier-4, 5 tier-6, 0 tier-7) are already inside docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-identity.json as part of the frozen 400, and contracts.gate_media_identity refuses a supplement that duplicates a base D1 sample, so they are verified against the parent manifest byte for byte and skipped. Tier 7 contributes none of those 18 by construction: every tier-7 id the parent D1 records was excluded from the population. Builder: scripts/build_a2t_tier1_official_population_d1_supplement.py, which is roster-parameterised and reused unchanged.
a2t_calibration_scoring_identity: 1,954 of the 2,000 sample ids are new to data.audio2tool's frozen-receipt universe and enter it through docs/receipts/probe-samples/a2t-tier3467-official-population-2000.json; the other 46 already resolve through r1-audio2tool-sample.json (18) and the two 104-row post-seal AgentLoop scoring receipts (15 + 13), and a probe-sample receipt that repeated them would be refused as a duplicate. a2t_calibration_no_driver_split_name: This fragment deliberately declares no split_name key. split_id names the receipt-scoped split the calibration adapter resolves from the hash-pinned roster receipt above; it is never resolved through the generic probe-receipt universe.
a2t_calibration_longest_row_note: Three rows of this roster are the release's 654-second synthesis defect -- tier3_multi_intent:003555 (654.6325 s), tier6_correction:003151 (654.635667 s) and tier7_multiturn:001033 (654.635667 s) -- the same defect the tier-1 official population contributed once as tier1_direct:003943. Under the mmproj encoder's one-second window rule n_tokens = 13 * ceil(audio_seconds) the worst of them costs 8,515 speech tokens, so the worst request needs 3,581 text + 8,515 speech + 256 completion + 2 special = 12,354 tokens. At the 49,152 total context this GPU is proven to serve on the raw path, -np 2 leaves a margin of 12,222 against the preregistered 8,192-token reserve and -np 3 leaves 4,030 and is refused, so this cell serves the tier-1 official-population geometry -c 49152 -np 2 (model fragment q4km-featcache-a2t-official-np2-04ccc72a, whose 900 s timeout exists for exactly these rows) rather than the tiers-2/5/8 cell's -np 3. Every other row of the roster is under 6 s on tier 4 and under 60 s everywhere.
